item.title: One Injured In Fire That Destroyed Chemstrand Road Home
item.description: One person was injured in a New Year’s Eve Fire on Chemstrand Road, Escambia County Fire Rescue said on Friday. item.title: New Palafox Project Begins Monday In Downtown Pensacola
item.description: Pensacola’s New Palafox project is set to get underway on Monday. item.title: Learn The Fundamentals Of Playing The Dulcimer At The Molino Library
item.description: You can learn the fundamentals of playing the mountain dulcimer at the Molino Library on Monday.
